const key = Symbol('key');
function reflect(value: object) {
  if (key in value) { const own: keyof typeof value = key; console.log(value[own]); }
}
function narrowed(value: string | number) {
  if (typeof value === 'string') { const copy: typeof value = 'copy'; console.log(copy.toUpperCase()); }
}
function before() {
  type Later = typeof value;
  let value: string | number = 'later';
  const copy: Later = 1;
  console.log(copy, value);
}
function unassigned() {
  let value: number;
  type NumberValue = typeof value;
  const copy: NumberValue = 2;
  let empty;
  const nothing: typeof empty = undefined;
  console.log(copy, nothing);
}
function member(value: {item: string | number}) {
  if (typeof value.item === 'string') { const copy: typeof value.item = 'member'; console.log(copy.toUpperCase()); }
}
function captures() {
  let value: string | number = 'initial';
  const arrow = () => { const copy: typeof value = 'captured'; return copy.toUpperCase(); };
  function deferred() { const copy: typeof value = 3; return copy; }
  console.log(arrow(), deferred());
}
reflect({[key]: 3});
narrowed('text');
before();
unassigned();
member({item: 'text'});
captures();
function snapshot() {
  let value: string | number = 'initial';
  type Initial = typeof value;
  value = 1;
  const copy: Initial = 'snapshot';
  console.log(copy, value);
}
function beforeMember() {
  type Item = typeof later.item;
  const later = {item: 1};
  const copy: Item = 2;
  console.log(copy, later.item);
}
snapshot();
beforeMember();
